nodes.summary: CLIQUE lies in NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to CLIQUE.
nodes.title: CLIQUE is NP-complete

nodes.summary: Every decision problem $L$ in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to CLIQUE: a polynomial-time computable map $f$ on bit strings such that, for every bit string $x$, $L$ accepts $x$ exactly when CLIQUE accepts $f(x)$.
nodes.title: CLIQUE is NP-hard

nodes.summary: INDEPENDENT-SET lies in NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to INDEPENDENT-SET.
nodes.title: INDEPENDENT-SET is NP-complete

nodes.summary: Every decision problem $L$ in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to INDEPENDENT-SET: a polynomial-time computable map $f$ on bit strings such that, for every bit string $x$, $L$ accepts $x$ exactly when INDEPENDENT-SET accepts $f(x)$.
nodes.title: INDEPENDENT-SET is NP-hard

nodes.summary: For a mode $m$ (clique, independent set or vertex cover), this is the host component whose stacks are $X, W, C, N, V, T$, each over the symbol alphabet of the SAT verifier, and whose labels and program are those of the verifier machine of mode $m$.
nodes.title: The CLIQUE, INDEPENDENT-SET and VERTEX-COVER verifier as a host component

nodes.summary: Let $L$ be a decision problem, let $m$ be a mode (clique, independent set or vertex cover), and let $V_m$ be the verifier of mode $m$. If for every bit string $x$, $L$ accepts $x$ exactly when there is a bit string $w$ with $|w| \le |x|$ such that $V_m$ accepts $(x, w)$, then $L$ is in NP.
nodes.title: NP membership from the CLIQUE, INDEPENDENT-SET and VERTEX-COVER verifier

nodes.summary: The decision problem VERTEX-COVER, which accepts exactly the valid encodings of a number $k$ and a graph $G$ such that $G$ has a vertex cover of exactly $k$ vertices, is in NP.
nodes.title: VERTEX-COVER (exact size `k`) is in NP

nodes.summary: The decision problem VERTEX-COVER, which accepts exactly the valid encodings of a number $k$ and a graph $G$ such that $G$ has a vertex cover of exactly $k$ vertices, is in NP, and every decision problem in NP reduces to it by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: VERTEX-COVER (exact size `k`) is NP-complete

nodes.summary: Every decision problem in NP reduces by a polynomial-time many-one reduction to the decision problem VERTEX-COVER, which accepts exactly the valid encodings of a number $k$ and a graph $G$ such that $G$ has a vertex cover of exactly $k$ vertices.
nodes.title: VERTEX-COVER (exact size `k`) is NP-hard
